SplitPane widget

Source: R/widget-split.R
SplitPane-class.Rd

Two panes with a draggable divider. See split_pane().

Super class

Widget -> SplitPane

Public fields

direction

"horizontal" (panes side by side) or "vertical" (stacked).

min_size

Smallest size of a pane in cells (when there is room).

Active bindings

ratio

Share of the first pane (0 to 1). Assigning moves the divider (limited by min_size).

sizes

The current sizes (cells) of the two panes.

SplitPane$new()

Create a split pane. See split_pane().

Usage

SplitPane$new(
  first,
  second,
  direction = "horizontal",
  ratio = 0.5,
  min_size = 3L,
  id = NULL,
  classes = NULL,
  style = NULL
)

Arguments

first, second

The two panes (widgets).

direction, ratio, min_size

See split_pane().

id, classes, style

See Widget.

Split the content area between the panes and the divider.

SplitPane$move_divider()

Move the divider by some cells.

Usage

SplitPane$move_divider(cells)

Arguments
